{{Quotation|game|
For centuries the [[House zu Heltzer (Great House)|zu Heltzers]] have expanded and remodeled their House cathedral, adding new wings and levels on a yearly basis. Recently, the [[Council of Nobles]] determined the cathedral and the area around it should have an official name, since it had grown to the size of a large town. [[Count zu Heltzer]] predictably suggested the area be called [[Cathedral zu Heltzer]], but the other House Nobles wouldn't hear of it, and '''Arborstone''' won the final vote.
}}

==Getting there==
The quest [[The Count's Daughter]] leads players here. [[Lift Operator Shulz]] doesn't let players enter the outpost before that.

==Notes==
{{gw2w|Arborstone}}
*You can get here without The Count's Daughter quest, by having more unspent faction of the allegiance not controlling Tanglewood Copse and not activating the resurrection shrine outside of Tanglewood Copse (by bribing the priest or killing the resurrection shrine NPCs). When your party [[wipe]]s, your party will be resurrected at a shrine closer to Altrumm Ruins and/or the Arborstone outpost.
